author: KEXP
description: Under the musical project Hatchie, Australian artist Harriette Pilbeam explores the world through the lens of dream-pop shoegaze. Our latest in-studio session invites her to share a performance of "Only One Laughing" and more.
title: Hatchie performs "Only One Laughing" & more Live on KEXP
